content: {"episode_id":"ep-05083","cpt":"93271","denial_carc":"CO-97","necessity_paragraph":"The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness in the setting of known sick sinus syndrome and a personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction. We request reconsideration of the CO-97 denial based on this documented clinical indication."}
